title: Design, benchmark, or model? Code for climate stress tests of data-driven streamflow models in Central Asian mountain basins (v2.0.0)
description: Code accompanying the paper 'Design, benchmark, or model? Disentangling the apparent climate insensitivity of data-driven streamflow models in Central Asian mountain basins' (submitted to Acta Geophysica). Version 2.0 decomposes the climate response of XGBoost, random forest, ridge regression and LSTM models under three simulation modes and three perturbation schemes in nine snow- and glacier-fed basins, compares it with degree-day and elevation-banded HBV benchmarks with and without glaciers, and verifies the design in a virtual laboratory with known truth. Version 1.0 contains the earlier single-model stress test.
